d:
The Official (Abangifuni) Music Video by Romeo Makota & Eemoh 2025 Kotela Music
“Abangifuni” Which straightforwardly means “they don’t want me” when Eemoh sing he’s expressing a feeling of rejection or exclusion - that they don’t want me at home. The lyrics and accompanying commentary emphasize this tone of being unwelcome or not accepted
Emotional message: A powerful statement of rejection, resilience, and defiance - highlighting being unaccepted, yet still persevering.
Lyrics:
Kuye kwenziwe njani mase kunje?
Kuye kuthiweni mase kunjana?
Abangifuni ekhaya lami
Abangifuni ekhaya lami
